text:
Sara (CEO): Quick Friday pulse — short list of priorities and a few asks.
Sara (CEO): 1) Private EU rollout is on for Tue 09:00 UTC. Ops + Legal: confirm the compliance checklist tonight.
Sara (CEO): 2) Cost guardrail pilot: we want a soft cap at X tokens/min for experimental models to control burst spend. Finance + Product to validate.
Sara (CEO): 3) Data retention tweak: default logs retention moves to 90d for hosted, with opt-in 365d for enterprise. Legal to publish policy.
Sara (CEO): 4) Incident recap: last-night GPU evictions caused ~18m of retries for a subset of requests — we fell back to smaller model variants automatically. Postmortem incoming.
Sara (CEO): Metrics snapshot: p95 latency (hosted) ~120ms, error rate 0.7% (target <0.5%). Dedicated latency stable.
Sara (CEO): Asks: product/docs/legal produce customer-facing comms by Tue noon; eng to prioritize KV cache warmup fix; finance to run spend sim for cap pilot by Wed EOD. Acks? :eyes:

Ajay (VP Product): Ack. I'll open a single PR with: rollout timeline, customer messaging, and UI text. Will tag @docs @legal.
Ajay (VP Product): Freeze request — can we avoid console UX changes on Monday until the EU rollout is confirmed?

Maria (eng-sre): Noted on the GPU evictions. We've got a temporary kube tweak in place: `slot_preemption_retry=3` and circuit-breaker bumped.
Maria (eng-sre): Pushing a KV-cache warmup patch now (small, high priority).
Maria (eng-sre): Fenced snippet of the hotfix we applied:
```
# increase retry and warmup
kubectl set env ds/infer-node SLOT_PREEMPTION_RETRY=3
kubectl apply -f kv-warmup-config.yaml
```

Kevin (Finance): On cost cap pilot — I'll run a delta sim. Need baseline token counts per model and recent 7d burst profile. @Ajay can you share model list?
Kevin (Finance): Also want a projection of revenue impact for Dedicated customers if we force soft caps.

Tess (Head of Sales): Sales needs a customer timeline. If EU Private goes live Tue, we want a short FAQ + one-pager for major accounts. Will prep with CS.

Ash (eng-platform): Console freeze OK, but we need to merge the telemetry patch first to avoid losing trace data during rollout. I'll coordinate with @Maria to sequence deploys.

deploy-bot: deploy started for `private-eu` (commit abc123) by @Ash — ETA ~23m.

Sara (CEO): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the Friday all-hands with a 2-slide summary. Quick reminders: keep incident comms tight, avoid product UI pushes pre-rollout, and finance + product sync tomorrow 10:30 UTC.
Sara (CEO): If anything blocks the EU compliance checklist ping me directly. :pray:
